insights.claim: The operator implements defensive webhook architecture that gracefully degrades when no TLS certificate provider is available, enabling the same binary to run on both OpenShift and vanilla Kubernetes.
insights.reasoning: The configureWebhookServingCerts function dynamically detects whether OpenShift service-ca or cert-manager is available. This defensive pattern avoids hard dependencies on platform-specific TLS providers and may be a useful pattern for other RHOAI operators.
